name: @zanora/mcp-proxy
stderr:
zanora-mcp-proxy: usage: zanora-mcp-proxy <seller-url>

  The MCP endpoint of the seller whose tools you want to use, e.g.
    npx @zanora/mcp-proxy https://seller.example/mcp

  Wallet configuration comes from the environment, exactly as @zanora/mcp reads it:
  ZANORA_AGENT_KEY_FILE (or ZANORA_AGENT_KEY), optionally ZANORA_GATEWAY_URL,
  ZANORA_API_KEY, ZANORA_WALLET_ID, ZANORA_MAX_PRICE_MICROS and ZANORA_APPROVAL_ELICITATION.
